evidence_summary: The official Rock 19.3 release note states that add and delete options now use Edit access to the content channel instead of the Content Channel Item entity and identifies issue #6914.

Issue #6914 reports the affected behavior on Rock 19.1.8 and records closure, a Fixed in v19.3 label, and the linked closing commit; it is evidence of the report, not independent proof of every affected patch.

The immutable closing commit changes ContentChannelItemList.GetIsAddDeleteEnabled to authorize against the configured content channel and explains why entity-type authorization produced the reported defect.
